checks.detail: Candidate SHA-256 remained exactly 955b3b84d48dd1465c8ffd033bea4c6986d357f8c29c2710fd4c85e7de595572. All four referenced artifact hashes match, and freeze/source identity binds exact commit d6cbbad5751fd60698d94c368ca93e335bdf56f2 and tree c11266fc7999b4149e67cd28dc2f36b47e66a2fe.

d6cbbad only stops treating Git C similarity records as automatic violations. Rename records remain rejected; the independent raw delta must remain add-only canonical lowercase JSON with safe mode/type and no Windows alias collision; exact reuse of any prior evidence blob OID remains rejected. Tests cover similar-but-distinct refresh acceptance and exact-blob rejection even with similarity detection disabled.

Recovery checks require the retained grant, exactly one prior succeeded ticket, no pending outbox, and the expected old policy. Execution issues a second ticket under the recovered grant, begins that ticket, records trusted receipts, activates the reviewed policy with expected_active_sha256 CAS, finishes it, verifies both TaskReports against Authority, and requires the succeeded-ticket set to equal those two reports with no open, failed, in-doubt, or pending state.

The sequence is fail-closed: public verify_bytes runs before the Gate evidence commit; close requires working bytes equal committed HEAD blobs; public verify_bytes runs again after that commit and before public close_bytes; close replay must be idempotent; the closure receipt is committed separately. Final verification requires HEAD^ == preclose_head, rev-list output exactly one single-parent child, committed closure-receipt blob equality, and a delta exactly A of official_p0_closure_receipt_v342_cr007_t2.json.

Review was strictly read-only. Candidate, HEAD, and Authority/operational hashes remained unchanged; no scheduler or ACL mutation, research, backtest, data/KBase access, Campaign, Final Holdout, task execution, Authority mutation, or AUTO_ADVANCE activity was performed or observed.
